svg.metadata: {"logicalPartId": "puff_sleeve_image_right", "step": "clothing-raster-layering/step01", "sourceSvgAtGenerationSha256": "7aa5bd4cf51996698e06a657a8bc97ce357e207425f5dea5ca5240d3a25400a8", "actualAlphaSha256": "14d299ee0bce1d7ac6f249ff7f6430d673d8f7553830fab13690a588e8d52f79", "motionIdentity": "puff_sleeve_image_right", "ordinaryPaintLayers": [{"name": "0018 puff_sleeve_image_right :: depth_18", "level": 18}, {"name": "0030 puff_sleeve_image_right :: depth_30", "level": 30}], "regions": [{"level": 18, "layer": "0018 puff_sleeve_image_right :: depth_18", "region": "右袖内侧后绕窄接合，沿本侧出口回转接前袖30，形状按右袖实际不对称轮廓。；右袖口后侧暗窄弧，连回内侧后绕区；在前波浪袖缘30之后，开口不封死。", "span_file": "parts/puff_sleeve_image_right/depth-18-spans.json"}, {"level": 30, "layer": "0030 puff_sleeve_image_right :: depth_30", "region": "右袖膨起主袖面、固定花瓣及紫灰波浪袖口前弧，约 x548–663/y334–463；与 level 18 在开口两侧连续换向，前弧盖住后绕弧、根部由 halter_bodice 前衣面压住，保留出口真实空隙。", "span_file": "parts/puff_sleeve_image_right/depth-30-spans.json"}], "reason": "固定坐标下可见轮廓与实际KRA同步；保留生成的被遮接合；共同运动多深度以互补绘画片表达", "visibleHemCorrection": "按真实自由边和卷回反面归属恢复本片可见参考材质；被遮补全保留生成与Krita画笔。"}
